_design_note: Shape of the decay, one knob at a time. L01 was chosen to have the step small before the round-2250 plateau and was never tuned, yet it carries the largest effect measured on this line (+1.0976 on the tournament suite against F2, t = +20.2). Two variants separate its two parameters: L02 keeps the length and lowers the floor, L03 keeps the floor and doubles the length. Neither is predicted to win; the point is to learn which knob the effect lives on.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: learning_rate_schedule L01 -> L02: the floor drops from 20% to 5% of 5e-4, over the same 2500 rounds
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/m3_lr_decay_5000_vs3rb_20260827/ -- R02_9 with L01: repeat-measured tournament score 3.6371 (sd 0.121 over ten repeats), coins_share 0.3449, primary-suite 16.596
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: Both variants within the resolvable gap of L01 means the effect is not sensitive to the shape in this range, and L01 can be kept without further tuning.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: None stated. L01 was never tuned; whether it is near the right shape is unknown.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training-seed distributions, coins_share, the death split, the checkpoint curve (the control's did not flatten, unlike every constant-rate arm), and the ten repeat measurements individually.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_primary: The control's cross-seed sd on the loot-crate-with-opponents suite is 0.97, so a five-seed mean has standard error 0.43 and two arms measured once each need a gap of about 1.2.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Ten repeats of classic_versus_opponents against the control's ten. A single measurement settles nothing (section 7.26.3).
